title: Tuscan Chicken and Smashed White Bean Wraps
intro: This satisfying lunch is perfect to assemble ahead of time and eat at your desk. Smashed cannellini beans stand in for mayonnaise to bind this herb-packed chicken salad while keeping you full for hours.

ingredients.name: Skinless rotisserie chicken breast
ingredients.canonical_name: Chicken, broilers or fryers, breast, meat only, cooked, roasted

instructions: Place the beans in a medium bowl and mash with a fork until mostly smooth.
Stir the olive oil, lemon juice, garlic powder, and oregano into the mashed beans until combined.
Fold the chicken, sun-dried tomatoes, and artichoke hearts into the bean mixture until coated.
Lay the whole-wheat tortillas flat on a clean work surface and divide the spinach between them.
Spoon the chicken and bean salad over the spinach and spread into an even layer.
Fold the sides of each tortilla inward and roll tightly from the bottom to form a wrap.
Slice the wraps in half diagonally and serve.
variation: Swap the artichoke hearts for chopped roasted red peppers.
conservation: Keeps up to 2 days refrigerated; enjoy cold.
validation_warnings: Stage 4 qualifier: 'No-salt-added canned cannellini beans': the recipe uses a canned product but the match is cooked from dry (different water content, so a different weight basis). No candidate in the USDA shortlist satisfies it, so [175203] Beans, white, mature seeds, cooked, boiled, without salt was kept — treat this ingredient's contribution as an over-statement.

Stage 4 coverage: 'Extra-virgin olive oil': [748608] Oil, olive, extra virgin has no USDA value for fiber_g, protein_g (which would be summed as zero) — switched to [171413] Oil, olive, salad or cooking.

Stage 4 qualifier: 'No-salt-added canned artichoke hearts (water-packed)': the recipe uses a canned product but the match is cooked from dry (different water content, so a different weight basis). No candidate in the USDA shortlist satisfies it, so [168386] Artichokes, (globe or french), cooked, boiled, drained, without salt was kept — treat this ingredient's contribution as an over-statement.

[instruction_completeness] Dry-packed sun-dried tomatoes can be quite tough and leathery if chopped and eaten raw in a cold wrap. Consider either adding a quick step to soak them in hot water for 5 minutes before chopping, or simply change the ingredient to 'oil-packed (rinsed and drained)'.

[chapter_intent_fit] The recipe embodies the lunch chapter's 'make-ahead desk lunch' goal perfectly. However, the 57.5g total carbohydrate slightly exceeds the 55g main-tier ceiling. Consider reducing the tortilla weight spec from 120g to 100g (two 50g medium tortillas) to bring it cleanly under the cap.
